openingRequest.zh-CN: 请帮助我们评估并设计一个客户支持自动化方案，用AI来降低支持成本
openingRequest.en-US: Please help us evaluate and design a customer-support automation solution using AI to reduce support costs

visibleContext.zh-CN: 我们是一家软件即服务公司，运营着一个大型客户支持中心。管理层希望通过引入AI自动化来降低人力成本、缩短响应时间，同时不损害服务质量。支持团队规模庞大，工单类型复杂，还受到严格的合规约束。
visibleContext.en-US: We are a software-as-a-service company running a large customer support center. Leadership wants to introduce AI automation to cut labor costs and shorten response times without harming service quality. The support team is large, ticket types are complex, and the operation is subject to strict compliance constraints.

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 涉及付款、退款和账户信息的工单必须保留人工复核
visibleConstraints.en-US: Tickets involving payments, refunds, and account data must retain human review

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 客户工单数据不得发送到境外的第三方大模型
visibleConstraints.en-US: Customer ticket data must not be sent to offshore third-party LLMs

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 自动化回答不得编造政策，准确率必须达到质量红线
visibleConstraints.en-US: Automated answers must not fabricate policy and must meet the quality floor

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: AI只能提供建议，最终回复仍需人工确认
visibleConstraints.en-US: AI may only suggest; final replies still require human confirmation

deliverables.zh-CN: 支持自动化方案设计文档
AI与规则引擎的权衡分析
质量、延迟与成本的度量体系
deliverables.en-US: Quality, latency, and cost measurement framework

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你只有12个问题预算来了解支持现状
learnerRules.en-US: You have a budget of 12 questions to understand the support center's current state

learnerRules.zh-CN: 每个问题必须指定由哪位干系人回答
learnerRules.en-US: Each question must specify which stakeholder will answer

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你需要在DISCOVERY阶段逐步发现隐藏的业务事实
learnerRules.en-US: You need to gradually discover hidden business facts in the DISCOVERY phase

learnerRules.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段你需要向管理层展示方案并争取批准
learnerRules.en-US: In the PITCH phase, you must present the solution to management for approval
